verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents one concrete in-product AI insight feature: Sprinto AI validates uploaded evidence for relevance, scope and timeliness before audit submission, which is AI-generated analysis of the customer's own data. Its AI Editor builds ingestion workflows from natural-language prompts, but that is authoring help rather than insight into data. The GDPR gap-analysis and PII skills run in external coding agents, not inside the product, and the AI-systems and Shadow AI modules govern AI tools rather than generate insights. Missing for 10: broader AI insights or recommendations across compliance posture, risks or controls, explicit AI-generated remediation suggestions, in-depth documentation of how the AI analysis works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
